cancellation.requestedBody: Portcove will stop after the current step reaches a safe stopping point.

diagnostic.availabilityUnknownWithPrevious: Current log availability is unknown. Showing the last loaded capture; it may have changed since it was read.
diagnostic.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the retained log below.
diagnostic.complete: Both output streams ended. Saved output is shown below.
diagnostic.incomplete: Only the output saved before the last observation is available. Later output may be missing.
diagnostic.loadFailed: Preparation log could not be loaded
diagnostic.none: No retained diagnostic capture is available. Older activity details may be available in a redacted support report in Settings.
diagnostic.readingWithPrevious: Reading the retained log… Showing the last loaded capture while the current log is checked.
diagnostic.truncated: Some output was omitted because it exceeded the {{limit}} capture limit per stream.

recovery.checking: Checking the library for unfinished work…

description.clear: No setup working files remain. Clear the unfinished setup record and its recorded path if present.
description.delete: Delete the private working files left by this unfinished setup. Review the affected folder and preserved locations first.
description.inspect: Review what remains from this setup and the locations recorded with it. Opening this review does not change files. Cleanup is a separate decision.

cleanup.failure: Cleanup was not accepted. The retained recovery state remains unchanged.

title.delete: Delete files left by unfinished setup?

details.clearScope: No setup working files were found. Cleanup clears the recorded setup path if it exists and its stale recovery journal.
details.deleteScope: This deletes only the recorded setup working folder and its recovery journal. The deleted files cannot be recovered. If cleanup is interrupted, Portcove keeps the accepted cleanup in its journal and retries it when the library reopens.
details.inspectLabel: Retained setup files and recorded locations
details.locations: Installation, game files, saves, backups and logs
details.noEntries: No retained private entries were found.
details.nowText: Keep the files and return to the game to review its next steps, or review cleanup separately. Opening cleanup checks the current files again before you decide what to remove.
details.remainsFiles: Setup left working files behind. This review does not confirm that those files are complete or ready to play.
details.remainsRecord: No private working files were found. An unfinished setup record remains.
details.stopClear: Portcove must confirm that setup and any programs it started have stopped before clearing this record.
details.stopDelete: Portcove must confirm that setup and any programs it started have stopped before deleting these files.
details.stopInspect: Setup and any programs it started must have stopped before cleanup can run.

recovery.failed: Recovery information could not be refreshed: {{error}}
recovery.failedRetained: Recovery information could not be refreshed: {{error}} The last completed check remains visible.
recovery.heading: Unfinished work and recovery
recovery.incomplete: Journal or related assessments are incomplete. Retained state requires review; no repair was attempted.
recovery.intro: Expand an item for its recorded location and guidance. Review links do not change files.
recovery.label: Unfinished work and recovery
recovery.refreshing: Refreshing recovery information. The last completed check remains visible.
recovery.stale: Recovery information is out of date. The last completed check remains visible.
recovery.unchecked: Recovery information has not been checked for the current library state.
